title: A bill to waive the 60-day notice requirement for the posthumous honorary promotion of Captain Cody Khork, United States Army.
official_summary: This act allows for the posthumous honorary promotion of Captain Cody Khork to the rank of major in the Army without the required 60-day notice to Congress.

summary.headline: Law lets the Army give Captain Cody Khork an honorary promotion to major after his death without the usual 60-day notice to Congress.
summary.what_it_does: This law waives the normal rule requiring 60 days' notice to Congress so that the late Captain Cody Khork of the U.S. Army can receive an honorary promotion to the rank of major.
